references.text: The priests who carried the ark of the covenant were commanded to stand still in the Jordan, which is fulfilled here
The priests who carried the ark of the covenant stood on dry ground in the middle of the Jordan while all Israel crossed over
Moses gave a command to Joshua, which is now being followed at the River Jordan
The Lord gave Joshua a command through Moses, which is now being carried out
Moses laid his hands on Joshua and gave him a command, which Joshua is now following
The poles of the ark, which the priests used to carry the ark in the Jordan
The priests came up from the Jordan after the people had crossed over
